name: fetchcv-desktop
description: FetchCV local-first resume and job application agent
author: hesan

scripts.desktop:package: npm run build && npm run sidecar:build && electron-builder
scripts.desktop:package:installer: npm run build && npm run sidecar:build && electron-builder --mac zip --publish never && node scripts/build-mac-pkg.mjs
scripts.desktop:package:signed: FETCHCV_REQUIRE_SIGNING=1 npm run signing:check && npm run build && npm run sidecar:build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.test:unit: npm run backend:test && node --test tests/provider-models.test.mjs tests/chat-scroll.test.mjs tests/processing-disclosure.test.mjs tests/composer-layout.test.mjs tests/interaction-inputs.test.mjs tests/sidebar-grouping.test.mjs tests/window-chrome.test.mjs tests/resume-editor-layout.test.mjs tests/agent-platform-ui.test.mjs tests/job-description-import.test.mjs
scripts.test:electron: npm run build && node --test tests/chat-scroll.test.mjs && node tests/electron.e2e.mjs
scripts.test:provider: npm run build && node --test tests/provider-models.test.mjs && node tests/provider.e2e.mjs
scripts.test:real-materials: node scripts/run-python.mjs -m pytest backend/tests/test_agent_real_materials.py backend/tests/test_resume_continuity.py -q && node --test tests/job-description-import.test.mjs
scripts.backend:migrate: node scripts/run-python.mjs -m alembic -c backend/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run build && npm run test:unit
